adf_pipeline.description: Azure Data Factory or Synapse pipeline definition

adf_activity.description: Activity inside an ADF or Synapse pipeline

adf_dataset.description: ADF dataset abstraction used by activities

adf_linked_service.description: ADF linked service or connection definition

adf_trigger.description: ADF trigger that starts one or more pipelines

adf_data_object.description: Table-like object referenced by an ADF dataset

adf_storage_path.description: File or folder path referenced by an ADF dataset

synapse_external_table.description: Synapse serverless external table backed by lake files

sql_script.description: Legacy SQL script, procedure or DDL artifact

relationship_types.orchestrates: A parent orchestration object invokes a child step
relationship_types.reads: An activity or code asset reads a dataset or object
relationship_types.writes: An activity or code asset writes a dataset or object
relationship_types.uses_connection: A dataset or task uses a connection object
relationship_types.points_to: A dataset references a physical table or storage path
relationship_types.depends_on: An asset depends on another asset
relationship_types.references: Code references an object by name
